title: 第十五章 一次磨皮武道无瓶颈第十六章 虎熊鹿蛇鱼有钱你就吃
lines: 次日。
林砚抵达演武场，发现自家师傅竟然也在。
自从当初拜师之后，他已经有一个多月没见到师傅了。
难不成是昨日的对拳传到师傅耳中，师傅特意为自己而来？
但很快，林砚就知道自己自作多情了。
在他前脚踏入演武场，后脚院门口就出现了两道身影，两位少年几乎是前后脚踏入院子。
看到进来的两位少年，院子里不少弟子都沸腾了。
“竟然是赵师弟。”
“赵师弟也养基成功了？这才过去了几天啊。”
“五天，当时赵师弟入前院的时候，我也在前院，满打满算也就五天。”
“没记错的话，赵师弟今年才十六岁，太恐怖了!”
听着身边其他弟子的议论，林砚明白怎么回事了。
这是前院的天才弟子入中院了，五天时间就养基成功，也难怪会惊动到师傅。
两位少年走向杨青锋跟前，走在前面的少年意气风发，脸上充满着自信，而落后其几步的少年，神情很是平静，甚至还低着头，似乎有些不适应成为众人的视线焦点，哪怕只是众多弟子余光的汇聚。
“弟子赵临渊拜见师傅。”
“弟子庄正拜见师傅。”
两少年一前一后开口，林砚眼睛却是微微眯起，赵临渊这名字取得不错，但庄正这名字他好像是在哪里听过或者是见到过。
很快，林砚便是想起在哪里见到过“庄正”这个名字了。
张大海的那本账册里，写着“庄正借五十两”。
同名不同人吗？
林砚不敢确定，能够直接从武馆前院开始修炼的人，按理来说都是家里不缺钱的，不可能找张大海这种下套之人借五十两。
“五天，不错。”
杨青锋看向赵临渊的眼神很是满意，五天就气血足够，比他想象的还要快一些。
他给赵临渊定下的时间是十天。
哪怕再有钱买秘药，那也得身子能够吸收的了。
至于说那些可以无视身体负荷的宝药，整个广平县城都没哪家吃得起。
对赵临渊，杨青锋不掩饰自己的满意，而对庄正虽然没对赵临渊这般满意，但也是面带笑容鼓励：“一个半月气血达标，也是不错，日后武道修炼勤勉一些，也能有所成就。”
“弟子牢记师傅教诲，定不敢有一丝一毫松懈。”庄正依然低着头，恭敬回答。
和当初教导林砚一样，杨青锋没有再说什么，直接开始传授劈山拳。
许多弟子在一旁围观，好几位劈山拳还没完全熟练，借着这机会再观摩几遍，林砚也是站在一旁，不过他和其他弟子不一样，他想看看师傅的劈山拳和自己现在的劈山拳有没有差别。
一遍看下来，林砚脸上有着若有所思之色。
师傅的劈山拳招式，比起自己多了一股气势，而且他敏锐察觉出，师傅还是收了势的。
等到师傅开始一招一招教导赵临渊两人时候，林砚没再围观，而是走到一侧继续练起自己的劈山拳。
脑海中的树叶，几近圆满，就差这么最后一蹴了。
“这一招，身体……“
啪！
content_en:
The next day.
Lin Yan arrived at the martial arts arena and found that his master was also there.
He hasn't seen his master for more than a month since he first became a disciple.
Could it be that the news of yesterday's fist fight reached the master's ears, and the master came here specifically for him?
But soon, Lin Yan realized that he was being sentimental.
When he stepped into the martial arts arena, two figures appeared at the door of the courtyard. The two young men almost stepped into the courtyard front and back.
Seeing the two young men coming in, many disciples in the courtyard were excited.
"It turned out to be Junior Brother Zhao."
"Junior Brother Zhao has also succeeded in raising his foundation? It has only been a few days."
"Five days. When Junior Brother Zhao entered the front yard, I was also in the front yard. It only takes five days if we give it a try."
"If I remember correctly, Junior Brother Zhao is only sixteen years old this year, which is terrifying!"
Listening to the discussions of other disciples around him, Lin Yan understood what was going on.
This is the talented disciple from the front courtyard who has entered the middle courtyard. He has successfully cultivated his skills in five days. It is no wonder that the master is alarmed.
The two young men walked towards Yang Qingfeng. The young man walking in front was high-spirited and his face was full of confidence, while the young man who was a few steps behind had a very calm expression and even lowered his head, as if he was not used to being the focus of everyone's attention, even if it was just the peripheral vision of many disciples.
"Disciple Zhao Linyuan pays homage to the master."
"Disciple Zhuang Zheng pays homage to the master."
The two young men spoke one after the other, but Lin Yan narrowed his eyes slightly. He knew the name Zhao Linyuan well, but he seemed to have heard or seen the name Zhuang Zheng somewhere.
Soon, Lin Yan remembered where he had seen the name "Zhuang Zheng".
In Zhang Dahai's account book, it was written, "Zhuang Zheng borrowed fifty taels."
Different people with the same name?
Lin Yan was not sure. People who could start training directly in the front yard of the martial arts school had a family that was not short of money. It was impossible to borrow fifty taels from a trickster like Zhang Dahai.
"Five days, not bad."
Yang Qingfeng looked at Zhao Linyuan with very satisfied eyes. He had enough energy and blood in five days, which was faster than he thought.
The time he set for Zhao Linyuan was ten days.
No matter how much money you have to buy the secret medicine, your body must be able to absorb it.
As for those precious medicines that can ignore the physical load, no one in Guangping County can afford them.
For Zhao Linyuan, Yang Qingfeng did not hide his satisfaction. For Zhuang Zheng, although he was not as satisfied as Zhao Linyuan, he encouraged him with a smile: "It's not bad to reach the standard of Qi and blood in one and a half months. If you practice martial arts more diligently in the future, you can achieve something."
"Disciple, please keep your master's teachings in mind and dare not relax even a little bit." Zhuang Zheng still lowered his head and answered respectfully.
Just like when he taught Lin Yan, Yang Qingfeng didn't say anything else and directly started teaching Splitting Boxing.
Many disciples were watching, and several of them were not yet fully proficient in Mountain Splitting Fist. They took this opportunity to observe a few more times. Lin Yan was also standing aside, but he was different from other disciples. He wanted to see if there was any difference between the Master's Mountain Splitting Fist and his current Mountain Splitting Fist.
After reading it again, Lin Yan had a thoughtful look on his face.
The master's mountain-splitting fist move had more momentum than his own, and he was keenly aware that the master still held back his momentum.
When the master began to teach Zhao Linyuan one move after another, Lin Yan stopped watching, but walked to one side and continued to practice his Mountain Splitting Fist.
The leaves in my mind are almost complete, but they are just one step away from perfection.
"This move, the body..."
Snap!
